message.text: Dependency concerns found but code changes are clean.

properties.justification: No code-level issues found but 2 dependency concerns were identified. The dependencies have known vulnerabilities that should be addressed, though the code itself is safe to merge.
properties.recommendation: Update axios to version 1.6.0 or later and replace event-stream with a maintained alternative.

message.text: axios@0.21.1 has a known Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability (CVE-2023-45857). Update to axios@1.6.0 or later to resolve this issue.

event-stream@3.3.6 was compromised in a supply chain attack (npm advisory 737). This package injects malicious code targeting cryptocurrency wallets. Remove event-stream and replace with a maintained alternative such as highland or through2.
